verdict.rationale: Alloy documents its own first-party APIs for core operations: the Events API for real-time decisioning, and the Evaluation API, whose warnings appear in both the API response and the dashboard. That points to some API/UI parity for evaluation data. Nothing claims that everything doable in the UI is doable via the API, and re-enabling a webhook is described only as 'setting to active in your webhook settings.' Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, documented API coverage for workflow/Journey configuration, webhook management and SSO/SCIM setup, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Alloy's Events API allows you to build a real-time integration for decisioning on suspicious ongoing behavior as soon as it happens.
the warnings section in the Evaluation API response and dashboard gives additional information about what data was missing
Alloy will return results of the Source Workflow under the evaluations[] array in the Events response.
